title: Reactivate brings a tier back last with no confirmation
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived.
  • Note how many active tiers the Tiers list shows (for example 5).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Reactivate.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A shows among the archived rows.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Reactivate and Delete.

Step 3:

  • No question is asked.
  • A message reads tier A's name followed by "is reactivated. It's now the last tier, Tier 6." (5 active + 1 = 6).
  • Tier A is the last active row, number 6.
